title: Verify a caller id for outbound calls
summary: Three REST calls take a number you own elsewhere through verification as an outbound caller ID: register it, send back the code the verification call reads out, and redial if the code was missed.
scenario: A shop that wants outbound calls to show its long-standing mobile number

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/relay/rest/verified_caller_ids required [number]; PUT .../{id}/verification required [verification_code]; POST .../{id}/verification redial
